one_line_contribution: A crossover identification for agentic memory: at a fixed GEPA-optimized instruction and on the same test instances, compare the gain of the bank distilled from the episodes that instruction was optimized on (own) against the gain of a bank from episodes it never saw (other), so that headroom is held constant by construction and the own-vs-other difference (Delta_info) isolates how much of memory's value is information the instruction container already absorbed. The design, not a method, is the contribution.
closest_prior_work: Two threats, one conceded and one structural. (1) MIPROv2 (2406.11695) already factorizes a prompt into instructions plus bootstrapped demonstrations and reports instruction-only vs demonstration-only ablations on one training set - that IS the two-container question, and its recurring finding is that the split is task-dependent, which is close to what this proposal expects to find. It does not retrieve per query, does not distill, does not hold episodes out across containers, and reports no residual, so the crossover survives it. (2) EvoAgentBench (2607.05202, as the proposal describes it) puts Memento, ReasoningBank and GEPA on shared 528/267 trajectories across four domains and three backbones and already reports that GEPA nearly matches a curated reference on one backbone - which kills the 'nobody has compared them' framing (the proposal withdraws that sentence, correctly). The remaining delta is genuinely narrow: combined cells, token matching, the compiled arm, and the crossover. Note that I can verify the pre-2026 IDs cited here (2308.10144 ExpeL, 2406.11695 MIPROv2, 2507.19457 GEPA, 2509.25140 ReasoningBank, 2502.12110 A-MEM) and they are accurate, but every 26xx ID is past my own knowledge and I am taking the proposal's characterization of them on trust. Also close in shape: Experience Distillation (2607.21051), whose 'retains >=64.8% of the in-context gain' is the same retention-ratio object with weights as the second container - if that paper's method section contains a prompt-container arm, the novelty of the ratio itself is gone and only the own/other crossover remains.
strongest_objection: The primary endpoint is a ratio of two small, noisy quantities measured in the single cell hand-picked to make them as large as possible, and the headline generalizes from that cell to a whole literature. Concretely: A1 is the argmax over four agent x format pairings of the paired memory gain on S_dev at n=300, where the proposal itself states SE ~= 2.4pt. Selecting the maximum of four such draws under a >=6pt gate guarantees winner's-curse inflation of roughly 1.5-2pt, so the anchor gain g(I0,B_a) that looked like 7pt on S_dev plausibly regresses to 4-5pt on S_test. In that regime cells 6/7 and 9/10 give own ~1-2pt and other ~3-4pt, S_info = 1 - own/other carries a delta-method SE near 0.2, and the proposal's own rule declares S_info undefined whenever mean(other) < 3pt. The primary result can therefore be undefined or uninterpretable even when the hypothesis is true, and Prediction 1's conjunction (Delta_info >= 3pt AND S_info >= 0.5 with 90% CI excluding 0.2) survives only in a narrow window - roughly own <= 1-2pt with other >= 4pt at an optimized instruction. Risk 8 answers only half of this: it is right that S_info does not use the I0 denominator and so is not directly inflated by selection, but selection still determines whether there is any effect left to decompose. Second half of the objection: the paper is titled as a claim about the field ('Is Your Agent's Memory Just an Un-Optimized Prompt?') while Risk 11 explicitly refuses to re-measure any published number, and the robustness across agents is Qwen3.5-27B vs Qwen3-32B - two checkpoints of one vendor's family, with the only cross-family point (gpt-oss-120b, cell 25) declared out-of-scope, Tier 2, and first on the contingency cut list. The track brief demands that a methods contribution 'overturn or qualify specific existing results'; this qualifies an evaluation template using its own reimplementation on its own benchmark in its own most-favorable cell. Third, smaller but real: Delta_info > 0 does not distinguish substitution (the instruction already carries the lesson, so own-bank items add nothing) from interference (own-bank items duplicate and collide with an instruction tuned on the same episodes, which the track's own documented context-competition and dilution result makes likely). Those two mechanisms license opposite headlines and the moderator regression on similarity cannot separate them.
what_would_fix_it: 1) Pre-register the fix/break signature as a discriminating prediction, not a per-cell footnote: pure substitution predicts own has fewer FIXES than other at equal breaks; interference predicts own has more BREAKS. The instrumentation already logs this; make it Prediction 1b so the paper can name the mechanism instead of the ratio. 2) Promote the joint instruction+demonstration optimizer to Tier 0 (see missing_baseline) and add I1_ab, an instruction optimized on both halves (800 episodes), so the deployment question is answered at full data rather than only at half data. 3) Fix E2. The proposal states a treatment-free floor of 2.8-3.4pt at n=500; at ALFWorld's n=274 that floor scales to ~3.8-4.6pt, which exceeds the 3pt claim threshold and swamps the +/-4 TOST margin. Prediction 4's 'on E1 and E2' is therefore unsupportable as written; either raise E2's seeds and episode count until its floor is under 3pt, or state every E2 result as explicitly directional and stop citing it as replication. 4) Give the memory side a real equal-compute counterpart. B_tuned searches k in {3,5,7} plus a dedup threshold under a 350-rollout budget; that is hyperparameter selection, not a reflective improvement loop comparable to GEPA's, so outcome (viii) is not actually protected against. Add an iteratively re-distilled bank at matched rollouts and move the iso-cost arm off the Tier-2 cut list, since 'the second container is cheaper to serve' is doing rhetorical work the design currently checks only descriptively. 5) Retitle and rescope to what the design delivers: a substitution measurement for one screened agent x bank pairing in tool-augmented multi-hop QA, with the memory-null pairings reported as co-equal results rather than as an appendix. 6) Read the EvoAgentBench PDF before the design freeze, as already flagged - the entire remaining novelty claim is an absence claim about a paper nobody on the team has opened.
missing_baseline: The jointly optimized prompt - instructions AND demonstrations optimized together on the same training episodes, i.e. MIPROv2 in its actual published configuration or GEPA with the demonstration slot enabled. Every I1 arm here optimizes the instruction slot only, with memory absent from context, and the optimized-demonstration container appears solely as D_opt in cell 22: Tier 2, n=500, 1-2 seeds, first-block on the contingency cut list. This is the alternative a practitioner actually deploys and the true ceiling of the 'instruction container' argument. Without it the paper cannot answer the question it poses - if a jointly optimized prompt already matches I1b x C_a and I1a x M_a, then both the substitution finding and the 'compile once, do not retrieve' recommendation in cell 18 are moot, and a reviewer will say the study compared memory against a deliberately handicapped optimizer. Secondary omissions a reviewer will also raise: an instruction optimized on the union of both halves (I1_ab), absent entirely; and a matched-token, matched-decode compute control (e.g. self-consistency at the injected-token budget) to rule out 'any extra context/compute helps' - I3 pads tokens but adds no reasoning compute.
preprint_collision: Much better than the field norm in process, but its load-bearing conclusion is unverified. The good: dated scans (2026-08-21 and 2026-09-03), 15 named HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id abstract verification for 54 IDs, committed scan records, and an honest correction of v2's false retraction of five citations that turned out to exist. The proposal also concedes the collision that matters - EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) already ran Memento, ReasoningBank and GEPA on shared trajectories, and the sentence claiming no such comparison exists is withdrawn. That concession is what a real check looks like. The defect: arXiv is unreachable from the node, EvoAgentBench's PDF was never opened, and the entire surviving novelty delta is stated as an ABSENCE claim about that paper's contents (no combined optimizer-plus-memory cell, no token matching, no paired statistics) resting on an abstract, a project-page method list, and search-surfaced descriptions of its Table 3. If that paper's appendix contains a +GEPA+RB combined cell - an ordinary thing for a benchmark paper with five methods and a shared split to include - the combined-cell claim collapses and only the own-vs-other crossover is left. The v2 episode cuts both ways: a search channel that produced five false negatives in August is not a channel that can certify a negative in September. Separately, the compiled-arm prediction is conceded to be directionally pre-empted (2608.14036 skills > Workflow Memory by 6.06pt; 2606.30775 single rewrite ~= iterative refinement), which is handled honestly by restating Prediction 4 as a quantified equivalence rather than a surprise. Net: the check is diligent and self-critical, and I am scoring it as a strength of the submission, but it does not yet establish novelty - the PDF check the proposal itself defers to the PI is a precondition for the novelty claim, not a nicety, and until it happens the residual risk named in the proposal (a 'GEPA + memory' ablation in some systems paper's appendix) is exactly the risk that would reduce this to a design-refinement paper.
